event_chain.summary: Suspected unauthorized access to member data

summary: Sarang Church, a South Korean megachurch, reported a suspected cyber incident in October 2026 after Oasis Security found attack records and data linked to the church (and to Yoido Full Gospel Church) on an overseas server, with signs that AI tools were used. The church formed an emergency task force and reported to authorities; it did not disclose what data or how many members were affected.
